title: Guest Suite - East Nashville Treehouse - 5 Points
description:
Guest suite in a cozy craftsman-style bungalow with modern amenities and  tree-top views! Separated with a private entrance and deck. Located in historic and hip  East Nashville: less than a 10 minute walk to 5 points, the Shoppes at Fatherland, Shelby Park, and more.  A quick uber ride to downtown. Enjoy the large deck, soak in the oversized clawfoot tub or just relax in the garden. Close to all of the restaurants, bars, shops, music, galleries that make East Nashville so unique.

The space
You'll have access to a large private deck with tree top views, a well equipped kitchenette, a large bathroom with a clawfoot tub and a large bedroom with sitting area.  There's a large backyard with a fire pit that's available as well.

Guest access
This suite is on the second floor of a 2 story house.  You'll need to follow a path around the side of the house and go up two flights of stairs into the trees to the private deck entrance. One of the flights is a spiral staircase
